purpose: Prospective Friday-after-close weekly recommendation synthesis. Shadow-only; it does not change Patch 6 ranking, confirmed trends, the visible dashboard, or Patch 7 path-risk predictions.

schedule.normal_capture: Friday after 16:15 America/New_York using Friday market data.
schedule.friday_holiday: If Friday is a market holiday, a Friday run may use the immediately prior Thursday close; recommendation_date remains the actual market-data date and week_ending_date records Friday.
schedule.weekend_recovery: A Saturday/Sunday rerun may capture an unrecorded Friday recommendation using Friday market data.
schedule.immutability: The first successfully validated recommendation captured for a recommendation_date is append-only and is never overwritten by same-date reruns. AI infrastructure failures do not create an immutable recommendation and may be retried.

evidence_strength.meaning: Evidence Confidence describes agreement among deterministic supplied observations. It is not a probability of profit or calibrated accuracy.
components: absence of a pending state change

ai_committee.provider: Gemini when enabled through the existing AI_PROVIDERS/AI_PROVIDER configuration
ai_committee.authority: AI may reject deterministic selectable finalists but may not introduce a ticker, change direction, change Evidence Confidence, or create numeric probability claims.
ai_committee.grounding: Selected actions must cite deterministic evidence IDs. If supplied conflicts exist, at least one conflict ID must be acknowledged. AI-authored rationales and summaries may not contain numeric claims.
ai_committee.no_action: No action is valid and preferred when evidence is materially conflicted.

outcomes.FAVOR_primary_success: median(relative returns at 63, 84 and 126 bars) >= +2% AND benchmark-relative max drawdown over 126 bars >= -10%
outcomes.AVOID_primary_success: median(relative returns at 63, 84 and 126 bars) <= -2% AND benchmark-relative max run-up over 126 bars <= +10%
outcomes.note: Outcomes are stored separately and may mature over time; original weekly recommendations remain immutable.
